lessons.text: Use the read-only ERP API: GET /vendors?q=<vendor name> to find vendor ID and email_domain, then GET /bills?vendor_id=<id> and GET /bills/<bill_id> to get invoice number, due date, amount, status, and payment_date before any GUI write.
For internal AP lead notification, open /mail/compose, fill To with an internal @kestrel.in address, Subject, and Message, then click Send; the UI returns 'Message sent' and saves to the sent folder.

Attempting to schedule a large payment (>= INR 50,000) on the ERP bill page without Finance Manager approval returns 'approval declined (large-payment)' and the decline is final, so do not retry; notify the AP lead instead.

The ERP read-only API's bill object does not expose an approval status field; Finance Manager approval is checked only when submitting the payment schedule action in the GUI, which declines large payments if not approved.

A bill with payment_date null does not mean scheduling is allowed; check bill amount against the INR 50,000 threshold and confirm Finance Manager approval exists in the ERP GUI before attempting to schedule.
